page.overview:
Who is Super Criminals?

The Super Criminals, known in Japan as , are an intergalactic criminal syndicate that took over earth during the events of Captain Commando. The group is composed of members who have been granted superhuman abilities beyond ordinary mortals through genetic engineering by their leader, Scumocide. In addition, their forces also include regular, non-enhanced criminals who hope for a chance to become Super Criminals themselves.
